firm_data.firm_description: Morrison Cohen gives you the best of all worlds: the range of experience of a full-service law firm, the personalized, senior-level attention of a boutique firm and the exceptional legal acumen of accomplished practitioners. They deliver end-to-end, business-oriented solutions that optimize outcomes for their clients.

email.subject: AI for Morrison Cohen — built for firms balancing boutique attention with full-service scope
email.body:
Hi Jenni,

Morrison Cohen's recognition as a Top 150 Under 150 firm with Band 2 rankings in crypto disputes tells me you're navigating complex, emerging practice areas without the overhead of BigLaw. That's exactly where we see friction most.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for boutique firms facing institutional demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters to practices like yours: precision in specialized work, client trust, and efficiency without sacrificing judgment.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding to New York and would love to show you how we're helping similar firms compete—and win—on quality, not just headcount.

Worth a brief conversation?

Vasu
Lucio
